# P9 · Practice operations and engagement — R9 · Ongoing

**Window:** Week 65 onward · 17 Jan 2028 → 24 Mar 2028  
**Delivered to:** All customers, by demand  
**Day one:** Features released individually as minor versions.  
**Goal:** Close the clinic operations gaps found against an open-source dental ERP: stock, external labs, payment plans, staff time, patient engagement and operational AI.

**Tickets:** 22 · **Estimate:** 48 dev-days vs **50 working days** in the window (fits) · **Average confidence:** 62%

**Status:** To do 22

## Epics

| Epic | Title | Requirements | Goal |
|---|---|---|---|
| MDV-P9-E01 | Stock and suppliers | P9-01 | The clinic knows what it has, what expires and what to reorder, without a spreadsheet. |
| MDV-P9-E02 | External lab send-outs | P9-02 | A test sent to an outside lab is tracked until its report is in the results inbox. |
| MDV-P9-E03 | Payment plans | P9-03 | A patient can pay a large balance in agreed instalments, and the desk sees what is due. |
| MDV-P9-E04 | Staff time and calendars | P9-04, P9-06 | Rota, attendance and leave in one place; doctors see their clinic day in their own calendar. |
| MDV-P9-E05 | Patient engagement | P9-05 | The clinic can reach consenting patients, hear their feedback and reward loyalty, within the messaging rules. |
| MDV-P9-E06 | Operational AI | P9-07 | Owners and the desk get forecasts and answers as drafts they can check, never automatic actions. |
